name: Self-Watering Smart Plant System
title: Self-watering plant system (alt to a $129 smart auto-waterer)
tagline: Closed-loop capacitive soil moisture irrigation system with 1.4L modular PETG reservoir, flow wheel & root-zone emitter stakes
description: A closed-loop automatic plant irrigation system combining a 3D-printed 1.4L modular reservoir, snap-fit port lid, submersible pump isolation cradle, ESP32 controller enclosure, silicone tubing clips, and soil drip emitter stakes with $29 of off-the-shelf electronics.
summary: A closed-loop automatic plant irrigation system combining a 3D-printed 1.4L modular reservoir, snap-fit port lid, submersible pump isolation cradle, ESP32 controller enclosure, silicone tubing clips, and soil drip emitter stakes with $29 of off-the-shelf electronics.
functionSummary: Monitors root-zone soil moisture continuously using a corrosion-resistant capacitive probe and triggers a quiet 5V submersible micro-pump through food-grade 4/6mm silicone tubing to deliver precise water doses directly to plant stakes.

keyMechanisms: Capacitive dielectric soil moisture sensing (3.3V analog feedback)
5V PWM/MOSFET switched centrifugal submersible micro-pump (120 L/h)
Gravity-isolated top-refill funnel and anti-siphon tubing guide clips
Root-zone targeted stake drippers with manual rotary flow restrictor wheel

engineeringNotes: Print reservoir-tank and pump-mount in PETG with 4 perimeter walls and 0.20mm layer height for 100% watertightness.
All 9 unique printed parts (13 total items) orient flat on the print bed and require zero slicer support material.
Packs onto 1 single 256×256mm build plate on Bambu Lab A1 / P1S / X1C.
materialsNeeded: PETG Filament (~160g) for watertight reservoir base, pump mount & snap clips
PLA Filament (~85g) for lid, refill funnel, controller enclosure, L-bracket, stakes & flow wheel
5V Submersible Pump + 4/6mm Silicone Tubing + Capacitive Soil Sensor + ESP32 + MOSFET Module
